bio: Julie Torrisi-Coffey is a principal product designer with 20 years of experience, the last five at Meta on Facebook Comments, Creators and AI. Her work reaches 3 billion people and her design systems are used by 300+ designers. She builds in Figma, Claude Code, Cursor and SwiftUI.
